codeReview.summary: This was a verification-only feature — no code changes were made. The worker systematically verified all cross-area assertions: (1) gradlew clean build passes with 25 tasks, (2) 5 platform-classified JARs produced with correct contents, (3) main sdk-native JAR excludes native libs, (4) .gitignore exceptions work correctly for native libs in src/main/resources, (5) version 0.0.1 and groupId org.feagi consistent across all POMs and build.gradle.kts, (6) workflow YAML is valid. Independent review confirms all these assertions hold true. The CI workflow correctly runs `mvn -Prelease clean deploy` on the repo's POMs (no separate CI-only config exists), and sdk-native/pom.xml contains the maven-assembly-plugin configuration that produces the 5 classified JARs during the `package` phase. The commit ID (ef32ff4) is actually from the prior feature (update-readme-consumer-docs) because this verification feature made no changes — this is expected and correct behavior.
